item.tib: kun bzang nam mkha'i rgyal po'i las chog 'gro don mtha' yas
item.coloph: zhes rgyal ba'i thugs spral gdung tshob dpal gyi ri bo na sbas pa'i zab gter 'di/ dus snyigs ma'i rnal 'byor o rgyan bde chen gling pa'am rig 'dzin kun grol gsang ba rtsal gyis dbus phyogs yongs rdzogs dpal gyi phug nas ma 'ong 'gro ba'i don du lung bstan mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho dang*/ gnas bdag rkong btsun de mos dus rkyen la tshigs 'phrod pa'i mthun sbyor yang yang bskul ngor sa rta zla tshes bzang por ngo mtshar zab mo rin po che gter du spyan drangs slar chu khyi sa ga zla ba'i dkar phyogs dga' ba dang pos (po'i) gral tshes dge bar gnas dus rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa'i sgor ye shes mkha' 'gro'i brda bcas shog ser ngos la spral pa'i rda (brda) ris dag la 'bri rdza zal mo sgong (sgang) thar bde kun bzang khrod du slad med du gtan la phab nas/ yi ge dang po ni 'chi med bla ma dgyes pa'i 'bangs skal ldan drung mu rdor dz+ras bgyis pa bkra shis//
